mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction_ledger (tx_id, account_id, tx_type, amount, balance_after, target_bank_code, target_account, description, status, transacted_at, created_at) VALUES (#{txId}, #{accountId}, #{txType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{targetBankCode}, #{targetAccount}, #{description}, #{status}, #{transactedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transaction_ledger WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND transacted_at BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') ORDER BY transacted_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction_ledger WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND transacted_at BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
